steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. How does a transformer neural network work, conceptually?

steps.action:
All tokens enter together.  
1  Embed tokens + add positional info.  
2  For every token build three vectors: Query, Key, Value.  
3  Self-attention: compare each Query with all Keys (dot-product), turn scores into weights (soft-max), use them to blend the Values ⇒ each token now “looks” at the whole sentence and gathers what matters.  
4  Do this in several “heads” so different relations are captured, then concatenate results.  
5  Pass through a small feed-forward net, add residual connections + layer-norm.  
6  Stack many such layers.  
The final contextual vectors go to a classifier or a soft-max to predict the next token.  
Key idea: Attention lets the model focus on relevant words instead of marching left-to-right like RNNs, enabling parallel, long-range reasoning.
